# Project families

Entries in the catalogue that belong together: forks, copies, ports to another device or format, the same mod built for two devices, and projects that build on another project. Use this to avoid counting the same work twice and to find the original. Each link names its evidence (GitHub's fork flag, or the project's own README). Data last verified: 2026-11-02. Edit the `relations:` field in `data/projects.yml`.

| Relation | Meaning |
|---|---|
| fork of / copy of | the same code base, continued (fork) or snapshotted (copy) elsewhere |
| port of / variant of | the same mod moved to another device, OS or format |
| same project as | two repos of one project (e.g. source and release) |
| builds on / bundles / describes | a separate project that depends on, packages or documents the other |
| relation unclear | same name or purpose, relation not stated by either side |


## Modded Cycles (18nelli18, Modded-Cycles contributors)

Devices: Model:Cycles, Model:Samples. [repo](https://github.com/18nelli18/Modded-Cycles)

- **Chord Keys** (Nico Heuser) - fork of **Modded Cycles** (GitHub fork flag). [repo](https://github.com/byNicoHeuser/Modded-Cycles)
- **Cycles Engines** (100demons) - builds on **Modded Cycles** (README credits); builds on **model27** (README credits). [repo](https://github.com/100demons/cycles-engines)
- **Cycles Mod Standard** (durchgemacht) - describes **model27** (README: implemented in model27). [repo](https://github.com/durchgemacht/cycles-mod-standard)
- **model27** (durchgemacht, 18nelli18) - fork of **Modded Cycles** (own README: beta fork of Modded Cycles 1.55). [repo](https://github.com/durchgemacht/model27)
- **model909** (DMDaudio) - builds on **Modded Cycles** (README: built on Modded-Cycles and Model-TG). [repo](https://github.com/DMDaudio/model909)
- **SPOKES** (A.V.) - bundles **Modded Cycles** (README table); bundles **model27** (README table); bundles **Supermodel Edition** (README table). [repo](https://github.com/AveyCole/SPOKES)
- **Supermodel Edition** (A.V., 18nelli18) - fork of **Modded Cycles** (GitHub fork flag). [repo](https://github.com/AveyCole/Supermodel)
